The '''Senate Budgetary Committee''' was a committee of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic]] and [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senates]] that oversaw the development of the budget for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

When a massive expansion of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] was proposed by [[Lira Wessex/Legends|Lira Blissex]], the Committee fiercely argued with the Starfleet and [[Imperial Military Oversight Commission]] over the necessity of the expensive project.
